en.headline: Parents arrested after 2-year-old left alone in Yuen Long village house
en.dek: A neighbour reported the toddler alone at a Kung Um Road address late on Monday; the child was found conscious with a swollen foot and taken to hospital.
body: Police arrested a 34-year-old man and a 30-year-old woman on suspicion of abusing or neglecting a child under their care after a two-year-old boy was found alone in a village house on Kung Um Road in Yuen Long.

Officers responded to a report from a neighbour around 9:55 p.m. on Monday. The child was conscious, with no other injuries reported beyond red swelling on one foot, and was taken by ambulance to Pok Oi Hospital for examination.
The couple, identified as the boy’s parents, were detained for further inquiries. The case is being handled by Yuen Long District’s Criminal Investigation Team 3.

zh.headline: 元朗2歲男童疑被獨留家中 父母涉虐兒被捕
zh.dek: 鄰居昨晚約10時報警指公庵路村屋有幼童獨留，警方到場發現男童清醒腳部紅腫，父母涉嫌對所看管兒童虐待或忽略被捕。
body: 警方昨晚接報後，在元朗公庵路一村屋發現一名2歲男童被獨留家中，其後拘捕一名34歲男子及一名30歲女子，涉嫌對所看管的兒童或少年人虐待或忽略。
事發於周一晚上約9時55分，鄰居察覺異樣報警。男童清醒，腳部有紅腫，由救護車送往博愛醫院檢查，暫無其他傷勢報告。
兩人為男童父母，現正被扣留調查，案件交由元朗警區刑事調查隊第3隊跟進。
